comment: NPC difficulty tuning. This file hot-reloads while the game runs (client AND hosted/dedicated server): edit it, save, and changes apply immediately (no restart). The keys with "comment_" prefixes are documentation only and are ignored by the game. See src/npc/npc-difficulty-config.cpp.
comment_maxAngularErrorDegrees: Aim miss-cone in degrees. Lower = more accurate = deadlier. 4 = arcade (most shots hit but some visibly miss), 8 = stormtrooper-ish, 0 = perfect aim (same as forceHit).
comment_difficultyErrorScale: 0 to 1. How much an NPC's difficulty (1-10) shrinks the miss-cone. 0 = all NPCs equally accurate. 1 = max-difficulty NPCs get the full reduction from maxAngularErrorDegrees.
comment_damageMultiplier: Multiplies weapon damage when an NPC hits the player. Revolver base is 12, so 1.0 = 12 per body shot / 24 headshot (natural attrition). Higher = more brutal. A 100 HP player takes ~8 body shots to die at 1.0.
comment_fireDelayMin: Fastest allowed seconds between NPC shots. Values below the weapon's own fire_delay are clamped to the weapon value. 0 = always use the weapon's own fire_delay.
comment_fireDelayMax: Slowest allowed seconds between NPC shots. Lower = NPCs shoot more often. ~0.3-0.7 keeps individual hits visible so you see -12 / -24 numbers tick down instead of a melt.
comment_aggressionBonus: Added to NPC aggression, which pushes shot timing toward fireDelayMin (faster fire). 0 = neutral, 1 = nearly always maximum fire rate. Keep low for a fair fight.
comment_npcHitRadius: Radius of the NPC's bullet (thin). Low = misses when aim is off (the error cone matters). High = fatter bullet that hits even with sloppy aim. Player's own weapon is unaffected.
comment_forceHit: Debug switch. true = zero aim error, every NPC shot lands on its target (overrides maxAngularErrorDegrees). Set false for the arcade feel; true to verify damage/fire-rate without worrying about aim.
comment_npcDebugVisuals: Draw the in-game NPC debug lines (LOS, aim direction, gun facing, labels). Set true to see what the NPC is aiming at, then flip back to false for normal play.
comment_turnSpeed: Degrees per second the NPC can rotate its gun/model toward its facing goal. Higher = snaps onto you faster. 270 = a full 180-degree turn takes ~0.7s. 0 = fall back to the per-difficulty value (180 at diff 1 up to 1080 at diff 10).
comment_aimAtTarget: Seconds the NPC stays in AIM mode (gun locked on you) each cycle. It spends this long staring at you before briefly switching to move-facing. 5-10 keeps most of every cycle shooting at you. Set min==max for a fixed duration; set max to 0 to never leave aim mode.
comment_faceMovement: Seconds the NPC stays in MOVE mode (gun points where it's running) each cycle. Keep short so it's only briefly 'shooting while running' before it re-locks onto you. 0.5-1.5 is a quick glance away, then back to aiming.
comment_movementPreset: Which config/movement/*.json preset NPCs use for their physics: "follow" = same as the player (current behavior), "default" = movement-default.json (mimita), "source" = movement-source.json (CS/Quake), "counterstrike" = movement-cs.json. Change it, save, and NPCs switch instantly (no restart).
comment_weaponLoadout: Which weapons NPCs can hold and switch between. NPCs spawn with startingWeapon and switch based on distance. All weapons in this list are pre-loaded with ammo at spawn.
comment_startingWeapon: Weapon the NPC spawns holding. Must be one of the IDs in weaponLoadout.
comment_switchCooldown: Minimum seconds between weapon switches. Lower = NPCs swap weapons more aggressively. 0 = instant switch on every decision.
comment_closeSwitchDist: Below this distance (meters), NPCs prefer close-range weapons like shotgun.
comment_farSwitchDist: Above this distance (meters), NPCs prefer long-range weapons like rocket launcher or grenade launcher.
comment_hitReactionEnabled: When true, getting hit forces the NPC into Recover state (freezes movement briefly). Set false for harder-to-hit NPCs that don't flinch. Default: false.
comment_hitReactionDurationScale: Multiplies the duration of the panic/freeze when hitReactionEnabled is true. Lower = shorter flinch. Ignored when hitReactionEnabled is false.
comment_dashChance: Multiplier on NPC dash frequency. 1.0 = current default, 2.0 = twice as many dashes, 0 = no dashes.
comment_downDashChance: Multiplier on NPC down-dash frequency (slamming down from above). 1.0 = default.
comment_freezeChance: Multiplier on NPC freeze-dodge frequency (briefly stopping to break prediction). 1.0 = default.
comment_movementNoiseScale: Multiplier on the random movement offset NPCs add to their path. Higher = more erratic, harder-to-predict paths.
comment_jukeFrequency: Multiplier on ZigZag/juke frequency. Higher = more frequent direction changes during movement.
comment_forceWeapon: Force all NPCs to use a specific weapon. When non-empty (e.g. "shotgun", "rocket_launcher", "grenade_launcher"), NPCs ignore weapon switching and only use this weapon. Set to empty string to disable.
